text.en:
The sum of twenty thousand pesos is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the Insular
Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to be devoted to the purposes mentioned in Act Numbered Nineteen
hundred and seventy-five of the Philippine Legislature.

The Director of Health may expend said sum, or such part thereof as may be necessary, for the
operation of the classes authorized by said Act Numbered Nineteen hundred and seventy-five, and for such
other purposes connected therewith as he may deem advisable and necessary.

This Act shall take effect on the first day of the fiscal year nineteen hundred and thirteen.
Enacted, February 5, 1912
